data.gender_notes: Altaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Altaf means soft, gentle, kind, and tender. This name is derived from the Arabic root letters ‘A-L-T’, which signify kindness and gentleness. Altaf is a beautiful name for a baby boy in the Islamic tradition. The name Altaf carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Altaf usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Altaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altaf total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
